findings.reason: The note says per-time CFU values are in supplementary file SuF1, which was not retrieved. This item therefore supplies time-kill conditions but no measured response series.
findings.needed_material: Authorized per-time CFU source records from SuF1, with isolate, concentration, time and response identifiers, if this experiment is used for PD analysis.

findings.reason: This page contains isolate MICs but does not identify a matching response record, dose-fractionation regimen, exposure input or mouse index-response panel.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported isolate-to-response, regimen, exposure and panel links for any proposed matched comparison.

findings.reason: FOF and MEM MIC columns are present alongside PMB MICs, while the project identifies PMB as the sole test drug. Preserve these columns as source context and review their downstream routing.
findings.needed_material: Independent review of whether the FOF and MEM columns have any authorized downstream use.
